summary: Fed held rates at 3.5%-3.75% on April 29, 2026 (third consecutive hold). 8-4 FOMC vote split. Inflation elevated above 2% target due to tariffs and energy prices. Markets pricing in no changes through 2027. Powell stepping down but staying on board pending legal challenges.
